edges.mechanism: High-dose vitamin E antagonizes vitamin K (PIVKA-II rise) and inhibits platelets; may potentiate vitamin K antagonist anticoagulation at >=300 mg/d.
edges.evidence: Small RCT (n=21) showed no INR change; mechanistic RCT of 1000 IU/d raised PIVKA-II; reviews list warfarin as plausible interaction; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Alpha-tocopherol inhibits platelet aggregation via protein kinase C; additive bleeding with aspirin.
edges.evidence: ATBC substudy: gingival bleeding highest with alpha-tocopherol + aspirin (33.4% vs 25.8% sites); human ex vivo platelet data; review

edges.mechanism: Antioxidant cocktail (vitamins E, C, beta-carotene, selenium) blunted HDL2/Lp(A-I) response and angiographic benefit of simvastatin-niacin; vitamin E alone did not alter HDL subfractions on statins.
edges.evidence: HATS RCT (n=160) and lipoprotein substudy; separate 2-y RCT of 1200 IU/d RRR-alpha-tocopherol null; moderate certainty for cocktail, low for vitamin E alone

edges.mechanism: High-dose vitamin E may alter cyclosporine A activity/absorption.
edges.evidence: Narrative review of vitamin E-drug interactions; limited clinical data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: High-dose vitamin E (>=300 mg/d) proposed to alter tamoxifen activity.
edges.evidence: Narrative review; limited data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Lipase inhibition reduces absorption of fat-soluble alpha-tocopherol.
edges.evidence: Open-label pilot (n=17 adolescents): reduced acute alpha-tocopherol absorption, serum levels maintained with multivitamin

edges.mechanism: High-dose vitamin E antagonizes vitamin K-dependent carboxylation; vitamin K reverses vitamin E-associated coagulopathy. Low vitamin K status amplifies bleeding risk.
edges.evidence: RCTs of 1000 IU/d (PIVKA-II rise); 2025 case report of reversible coagulopathy

edges.mechanism: Vitamin E alone raised prostate cancer risk in SELECT, mainly in men with low baseline selenium; the combination arm was not significantly increased.
edges.evidence: SELECT RCT (n=35,533) and case-cohort analysis by toenail selenium

edges.mechanism: Vitamin E combined with other antioxidants (incl. vitamin C) linked to more hemorrhagic stroke, blunted statin-niacin HDL response, and higher term PROM in pregnancy.
edges.evidence: 2024 MA of 16 RCTs; HATS substudy; Cochrane pregnancy review

edges.mechanism: AREDS formula (vitamins C, E, beta-carotene plus zinc) slowed AMD progression; vitamin E alone not shown to help.
edges.evidence: AREDS RCT (n=3640) and Cochrane 2023; moderate certainty for combination

edges.mechanism: Vitamin E raises hemorrhagic stroke risk (antiplatelet and vitamin K-antagonist effects).
edges.evidence: MA of 9 RCTs RR 1.22; PHS II HR 1.74; ATBC excess hemorrhagic stroke deaths; USPSTF harm signal

edges.mechanism: Vitamin E excess can produce coagulopathy when vitamin K absorption or function is compromised (malabsorption, bariatric diversion, vitamin K deficiency).
edges.evidence: Case report 2025; mechanistic RCT; IOM UL based on hemorrhage

edges.mechanism: Long-term 400 IU/d increased heart failure and HF hospitalization in patients with vascular disease or diabetes.
edges.evidence: HOPE-TOO RCT RR 1.13 (1.01-1.26); null in healthy women (WHS)

edges.mechanism: 400 IU/d all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate increased prostate cancer incidence.
edges.evidence: SELECT HR 1.17 (99% CI 1.004-1.36); +63% in low-selenium men

edges.mechanism: Occult gastrointestinal bleeding and iron deficiency during 200-800 IU/d, especially in diabetes; histologic benefit in non-diabetic MASH.
edges.evidence: Prospective series (n=20, 55% iron deficiency); PIVENS RCT

edges.mechanism: Vitamin E (mostly combined with vitamin C) did not prevent pre-eclampsia and increased term prelabour rupture of membranes.
edges.evidence: Cochrane review of 21 trials (n=22,129)

edges.with: vaping products containing vitamin E acetate
edges.mechanism: Inhaled vitamin E acetate associated with e-cigarette or vaping product use-associated lung injury (EVALI).
edges.evidence: CDC BAL study: vitamin E acetate in 48/51 EVALI cases vs 0 controls

edges.mechanism: Hp 2-2 protein binds hemoglobin poorly, raising oxidative stress; vitamin E associated with fewer CV events and better HDL function only in diabetic Hp 2-2 carriers.
edges.evidence: MAs of trial subgroups OR 0.66; 2024 SR; LURIC cohort interaction; post hoc, low certainty

edges.mechanism: CYP4F2 omega-hydroxylase initiates tocopherol catabolism; W12G increases and V433M (rs2108622) decreases activity in vitro.
edges.evidence: In vitro enzyme study; ATBC cohort found no modification of alpha-tocopherol-prostate cancer association

edges.mechanism: Physiological rise in under-carboxylated prothrombin from vitamin K antagonism (not an assay artifact).
edges.evidence: Two 12-week RCTs of 1000 IU/d

edges.mechanism: Vitamin E excess with impaired vitamin K can prolong INR and APTT; INR shifts possible on warfarin.
edges.evidence: Case report 2025; small warfarin RCT null

edges.mechanism: Falling ferritin, MCV and hemoglobin from occult GI blood loss during vitamin E therapy.
edges.evidence: Prospective MASLD series
